name: HE Group Berhad
overview: 2026年公司未公布涉及业务板块扩张、新增、缩减或出售的公告，所获公告主要为股东大会、股息、股份回购授权及季度业绩发布。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长44.0%，净利润同比增长61.3%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any business segment expansion, new business, reduction, or divestment. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue grew 44.0% year-on-year and net profit grew 61.3% year-on-year.
